contract_rule: All prior clauses remain mandatory unless explicitly strengthened here. The scorer hash-checks every contract. This candidate is the last autonomous amendment unless round 189 strictly shrinks the blocking set; a second consecutive non-shrink pauses this branch.

scope.claim: Greedy-argmax causal accuracy only; no cost, cache, prefetch, serving, or heldout claim.
scope.next_step_if_review_passes: Write and review RED packer/source/candidate/replay/scorer tests before implementation.

frozen_tensor_inventory.replacement: The v3 blk.78 wildcard is deleted. The pack exact-name/type/shape/original-range set is precisely the 255 allowed rows in this inventory; every other model tensor and any non-tensor/trailing/padding payload is forbidden. The 225 forbidden normal-expert ranges must be absent and inaccessible.

canonical_source_authority.source_sandbox: A clean reproducibly built source-only binary runs under a read sandbox that admits exactly the bound prompt, model, tokenizer/runtime, frozen binary/libraries, CUDA devices, and a fresh output directory. Corpus, split records, retained routes, candidate/replay/Phase-B results, network, IPC, ptrace, process_vm and other processes are inaccessible.
canonical_source_authority.execution: Tokenize the exact prompt, evaluate exactly the prompt token vector through position t, capture pre-output-norm h_t as z0, full source logits, q1=greedy argmax, checkpoint length, token vector, target-eval count, process/maps/FD identity, then publish and exit. The source helper has no future-eval loop or candidate/router scoring code. Exactly prompt_token_count target evals are allowed; any later eval or post-t checkpoint is FAIL.

canonical_files.z0.f32le: exactly 6144 little-endian finite F32 values, 24576 bytes
canonical_files.source-logits.f32le: exactly 154880 little-endian finite F32 values, 619520 bytes
canonical_files.q1.i32le: exactly one little-endian signed I32, 4 bytes
canonical_files.prompt-tokens.i32le: exactly prompt_token_count little-endian signed I32 values; count and bytes must equal independent tokenizer output
canonical_files.source-meta.json: RFC8259 canonical sorted-key compact JSON with one instance of the fixed keys schema_version, case_id, request_id, prompt_sha256, prompt_token_sha256, prompt_token_count, source_position, checkpoint_length, target_eval_count, model_sha256, tokenizer_sha256, binary_sha256, and artifact sha256/size map; unknown, duplicate, missing, noncanonical or trailing bytes FAIL

canonical_source_authority.independent_phase_b_check: Only after source and candidate/replay artifacts freeze, a distinct production-path Phase-B binary re-tokenizes the prompt and evaluates exactly through t in a fresh session. Before reading q1..q8 it publishes its own prompt tokens, h_t, full logits, q1, checkpoint length and eval count. These must be bit-identical to every canonical source artifact/value. Phase B then evaluates exactly the frozen q branch and captures target routes. Candidate metrics are not scored until this comparison passes.
mutations: alter z0 while preserving q1 and fail bit comparison
alter one source logit without changing argmax and fail
perform one future target eval and fail eval/checkpoint count even when canonical outputs are unchanged
append a byte/key/file, NaN payload or padding and fail exact schema/size
give source access to corpus/route/result path and fail sandbox preflight

admitted_payload_integrity.candidate_controlled_code: Source, candidate, replay, packer, validator, Phase-B helper and scorer each have explicit disjoint source inventories. Every executable is clean-built twice from reviewed tracked-clean source with the frozen compiler/linker command and toolchain/container hashes; its two outputs must be byte-identical. Candidate and replay are distinct binaries and neither has a mode that implements the other.
admitted_payload_integrity.runtime_libraries: Only root-owned system/CUDA runtime libraries already used by the frozen production engine may be admitted. Resolve each through O_NOFOLLOW, require root ownership and no group/world write, freeze dev:inode:size:SHA-256, and scan bytes. No user-writable library, LD path/preload/audit variable, JIT source/cache, plugin, config or helper executable is admitted.
admitted_payload_integrity.anti_canning_scan: Before freeze, scan all admitted source, diffs, executable/library bytes, symbols, strings, pack/source artifacts and build inputs for the five case IDs, request IDs, prompt hashes/content, forbidden tensor ranges/byte signatures, selected-ID tables, benchmark branches and hash/prompt detection. Also inspect disassembly/source for encoded/compressed lookup paths. Any match outside declarative evidence metadata FAILS.
admitted_payload_integrity.post_freeze_randomness: After every binary/library/pack/scorer hash freezes, obtain a fresh public-random seed. Derive at least five synthetic source tuples containing finite F32 z0 vectors, valid q1 tokens and valid positions/min_pos values from the seed with a fixed counter-mode SHA-256 generator. Neither known fixture identity nor Phase-B target data is an input. Candidate and replay must agree bit-identically on all synthetic recurrence/router/head transcripts before open-fixture capture; these synthetic results cannot grant the accuracy PASS.
smuggling_mutations: fixture IDs/routes in candidate rodata, replay rodata or shared library fail scan
compressed/encoded lookup decoder or fixture branch fails source/disassembly review
one trailing source or pack byte and one extra tensor name fail
one admitted user-writable library/config/JIT cache fails ownership/env preflight
binary rebuilt after public seed or target capture invalidates candidate

implementation_independent_replay.candidate: Production ds4 diagnostic source owns candidate orchestration: source-state ingestion, eight calls to the already-reviewed glm_graph_mtp_step CUDA primitive, direct post-residual capture, and candidate artifact publication. It contains no replay, scoring or target-route reader.
implementation_independent_replay.replay: A separately reviewed standalone source file and binary owns replay orchestration. It consumes only canonical z0/q1/t/min_pos, the exact tensor pack and synthetic tuple. It independently allocates/updates private MTP KV, invokes the frozen primitive CUDA operations in explicit j=1..8 order, captures post-residual z/head logits, recomputes all router/baseline ranks, and publishes its transcript. It has no fixture/case/request input and no candidate source file or candidate-specific orchestration linkage.
implementation_independent_replay.shared_boundary: Candidate and replay may share only the frozen production CUDA tensor primitives and immutable model-format constants. They may not share candidate-specific loops, stage receipt/publication code, score aggregation, source parsing, case dispatch, result schema writer or test fixtures.
implementation_independent_replay.independent_scorer: The Python scorer separately parses candidate and replay canonical artifacts, rejects any non-bit-identical z/logit/q/position/KV/rank value, derives metrics only from replay ranks plus Phase-B target selections, and never imports either orchestration implementation.
differential_mutations: alter candidate-only recurrence/tensor/position and fail against replay
alter replay-only recurrence/tensor/position and fail against candidate
link one shared candidate-specific loop or enable dual-mode binary and fail source inventory
canned outputs that pass known cases fail post-freeze synthetic tuples
candidate/replay process or binary identity equality fails

determinism.rule: Every frozen operation and artifact comparison is bit-identical. Any nondeterminism is unconditional FAIL/NO_RESULT for this candidate. No tolerance, rounding, majority vote, retry selection or comparison relaxation may be introduced after any trace value is observed; doing so requires a new preregistered candidate and seed.
determinism.mutation: A one-ULP difference in any z/logit or a retry-only match FAILS.
